completeness.reason: Covers User (all getters/setters, setPassword side effect of updating lastPasswordResetDate, UserDetails interface methods isAccountNonExpired/NonLocked/CredentialsNonExpired), Authority (getId/setId, getName/setName, getAuthority), UserRoleName enum (ROLE_USER, ROLE_ADMIN), UserTokenState (two constructors, access_token/expires_in getters/setters). All tested classes are fully covered. The setPassword(null) edge case updating lastPasswordResetDate is also covered.

unambiguity.reason: Key contracts are precise: setPassword updates lastPasswordResetDate to current timestamp, Authority.getAuthority() returns the enum name string, User.getAuthorities() returns Collection<? extends GrantedAuthority>. User.setPassword(null) still updates lastPasswordResetDate — the prompt says 'also update lastPasswordResetDate' for setPassword which implies even null calls trigger it, and tests confirm this.

testability.reason: Blackbox tests verify all getter/setter pairs, the setPassword timestamp side effect, UserDetails interface methods, Authority.getAuthority string format, UserRoleName.values() count, and UserTokenState field access. All derivable from the prompt specification.

consistency.reason: No conflicts. The default enabled=false is tested and not contradicted by the prompt. setPassword(null) updating lastPasswordResetDate is consistent with tests. Authority.getAuthority() returning enum name string (ROLE_USER, ROLE_ADMIN) matches specification. UserTokenState constructor with negative expires_in is accepted, consistent with no validation constraints mentioned.
